title: Venerada bir kun bir yildan uzun
rasmUslub: cinematic photorealistic space photography, deep dark cosmos, dramatic golden hour lighting, 8k resolution

scenes.text:
KUN YILDAN UZUN BO'LGAN
SIRLI SAYYORA
scenes.subtitle: Koinot mo'jizasi
scenes.ovoz: Tasavvur qiling, tug'ilgan kuningiz kun botishidan oldin kelib qolsa! Koinotda shunday sayyora bor.
scenes.rasm: Dramatic wide shot of a glowing golden-yellow rocky planet floating in dark starry space, photorealistic, cinematic rim light

scenes.text:
QUYOSH TIZIMIDAGI VENERA
JUDA SEKIN AYLANADI
scenes.ovoz: Bu bizga qo'shni bo'lgan Venera sayyorasi. U o'z o'qi atrofida aqlbovar qilmas darajada sekin aylanadi.
scenes.rasm: Close-up cinematic shot of planet Venus showing swirling dense golden sulfuric atmosphere, high detail, photorealistic

scenes.text:
BIR MARTA AYLANISH UCHUN
243 YER KUNI KЕRAK
scenes.ovoz: Venerada o'z o'qi atrofida bir marta to'liq aylanish Yer hisobida ikki yuz qirq uch kunga teng.
scenes.rasm: Planetary orbit representation in deep space with glowing planetary dust trail, majestic cosmic perspective, photorealistic

scenes.ovoz: Ammo uning Quyosh atrofini to'liq aylanib chiqishi bor-yo'g'i ikki yuz yigirma besh kun davom etadi.
scenes.rasm: Wide view of a radiant glowing star illuminating a rocky planet orbiting on an elliptical path, dramatic contrast

scenes.ovoz: Bundan tashqari, Venera boshqa sayyoralarga teskari aylanadi, ya'ni bu yerda Quyosh g'arbdan chiqadi.
scenes.rasm: Surreal alien rocky surface under a dense yellowish sky with a dim distant sun rising over sharp cliffs, hyper-realistic

scenes.text:
BU YERDA BIR KUN
BIR YILDAN UZUNROQ
scenes.ovoz: Demak, Venera sayyorasida bir kun uning butun bir yilidan ancha uzoq davom etadi.
scenes.rasm: Extreme close-up of an astronaut helmet visor reflecting a stormy golden planetary atmosphere, cinematic lighting

scenes.ovoz: Koinot sirlaridan doimiy boxabar bo'lish uchun obuna bo'ling va videoni do'stlaringizga ulashing!
scenes.rasm: Breathtaking view of deep space with luminous nebulae and glowing distant stars, epic cinematic composition

Obuna bo'ling va yangi sirlarni kashf eting.
